code:
SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Status == "Closed"
| summarize Incidents = count() by Classification

Usage
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where DataType in ("Syslog", "CommonSecurityLog")
| summarize VolumeGo = sum(Quantity) / 1024 by DataType, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)

Usage
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where IsBillable == true
| summarize VolumeGo = sum(Quantity) / 1024 by DataType
| top 10 by VolumeGo

Heartbeat
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize count() by Computer
| top 10 by count_

SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize count() by EventID
| top 10 by count_

SecurityEvent
| where EventID in (4728, 4732, 4756)
| where TargetUserName in ("Domain Admins", "Admins du domaine", "Enterprise Admins")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectAccount, MemberName, TargetUserName

SentinelHealth
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where SentinelResourceType == "Analytics Rule"
| where Status != "Success"
| summarize Echecs = count(), Dernier = max(TimeGenerated) by SentinelResourceName, Status, Description

Anomalies
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize Nombre = count() by RuleName, RuleStatus
| order by Nombre desc

BehaviorAnalytics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where InvestigationPriority >= 7
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, ActivityType, ActionType, SourceIPAddress, InvestigationPriority, ActivityInsights
| order by InvestigationPriority desc

SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where RiskLevelDuringSignIn == "high"
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress

IdentityInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize count() by AccountUPN

let critiques = _GetWatchlist('ServeursCritiques') | project DeviceName = tolower(SearchKey);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where EventID == 4625
| extend DeviceName = tolower(Computer)
| join kind=inner critiques on DeviceName
| summarize Echecs = count() by Computer, TargetUserName

_Im_Authentication(starttime=ago(1h), endtime=now())
| where EventResult == "Failure"
| summarize Echecs = count(), Comptes = dcount(TargetUsername) by SrcIpAddr
| where Echecs > 50

union withsource=TableName SecurityEvent, Syslog, CommonSecurityLog, SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(2d)
| summarize DernierEvenement = max(TimeGenerated) by TableName
| where DernierEvenement < ago(2h)
